scope: Project-run onboarding, editorial and UI regression checks. No outside users, new Lighthouse score, human listening or every-frame certification.

developer_ui.scope: Local browser interactions and 390px layout; graph response mocked and clipboard API stubbed. Documented copied code separately executed by clean consumer.

static_mobile.scope: Production build navigation: no irrelevant API requests/subscriptions and no horizontal overflow. This is not a Lighthouse or physical-phone measurement.

pitch.template: Forest-and-cream editorial redesign; real product captures and native editable diagrams, table and chart
pitch.visual_review: All eight current PPTX reimport renders and all eight Poppler-rendered PDF pages inspected. A separate project-run model critic found no release blocker. Slide layouts are preserved; slides2–5 are pixel-identical to the previous deck.
pitch.artwork: No generated conceptual illustrations. Actual product captures have dated provenance; screenshots remain raster images.
coverage: recorded test evidence and npm releases

remaining_gaps: One configured RPC supplies unseen-history completeness; no independent state/non-omission proof.
No unaided outside integration or established ecosystem moat.
Small separate root-update demo; no production migration or automatic policy rotation.
Mobile performance scores are historical simulated lab results, not physical devices or field INP.

hosted_ui.scope: Owned live domain. Actual MP4 playback/seeking and deck/package downloads; overview/SDK interactions and 390px layout. The SDK UI fixture and clipboard remain stubbed in its interaction case; real npm/RPC checks are separate receipts.

npm_production_audit.scope: npm audit --omit=dev on this checkout; not an audit of arbitrary applications.

editorial_refresh.scope: Static presentation and documentation refresh. All eight final PPTX and PDF pages reviewed, native table/chart and package structure validated. Existing unit and performance counts remain historical; not rerun for this media-only change.

checks.title: overview distinguishes infrastructure, keeps download evidence honest and opens the lazy film
SDK quickstart copies the exact runnable documentation example and fits mobile
static mobile views load without starting live admission reads or subscriptions
a missing historical verifier worker refuses the session and keeps consumers disabled
live root updates verify the published graph, reject local rollback/tampering and survive reload on mobile
root updates fail closed before acceptance if persistent storage cannot retain the checkpoint
malformed root history is refused without replacing saved bytes or querying the provider
a browser without Web Locks refuses root updates before RPC or checkpoint writes
a browser without Web Locks refuses a two-client task before its live RPC read
two tabs serialize root checkpoint reads and a queued older RPC snapshot cannot overwrite accepted history

final_patch_verification.scope: Two onboarding checks, two performance/failure guards and six root/checkpoint checks. Some failures use authentic evidence replay and controlled injection; live root and current withdrawal checks read real RPC evidence.

previous_google_slides_review.application: Google Slides native import, opened in authenticated Chrome
previous_google_slides_review.scope: All eight actual Google-exported PDF pages checked. Browser slideshow controls timed out; a full interactive slideshow pass is not claimed for this revision.
previous_google_slides_review.conversion_limitations: Google converts the chart to an image and rounds the display axis to120. Values remain0–100 and labels are fully visible. Native PPTX retains an editable chart/workbook.
